title: Honest codemode feature flags and agent_next_steps (runtime-detected availability)
problem: capabilities --json sets feature_flags.codemode_surface=true and advertises trampoline in agent_next_steps/codemode block, but PATH tokenzero 1.4.0 returns codemode:error missing feature surface-codemode/rquickjs (exit 1). Agents burn turns on a non-executable path. FCC-009.
diff_sketch:
Report codemode.available from compile-time/features at runtime.
If false: feature_flags.codemode_surface=false; strip or rewrite agent_next_steps trampoline lines; point to tokenzero-codemode package / install path.
Pin regression: capabilities.codemode.available matches live codemode probe.
test_plan: capabilities --json | jq .feature_flags.codemode_surface matches live codemode exit/status

title: Unify CLI JSON envelope (schema_version/status/tool/ack required)
problem: Agents cannot apply one jq predicate across verbs: 7+ schema families; doctor.health missing tool; install uses status=planned; codemode uses schema/visible_ack not schema_version/ack. FCC-002. Scorecard output_parseability mean ~627 overstates family health.
diff_sketch:
Introduce tokenzero.envelope.v2 required keys: schema_version, status, tool, ack; nest domain payload under data.
Migrate codemode schema→schema_version, visible_ack→ack.
Document allowed status enum; list envelopes in capabilities.output_schemas.
risk: medium -- multi-schema migration; versioned dual-emit during transition
test_plan: Matrix: for each read-side --json command assert required keys; golden fixtures in audit/regression_tests

title: run status-truth: expose command_success at top level; optional --fail-on-command
problem: tokenzero run --json -- false → process exit 0, top-level status=ok, tool=shell, telemetry.command_success=false. exit_codes[0] meaning 'completed' trains agents to ignore telemetry. FCC-006 / parity run-transport finding.
test_plan: run --json -- false asserts status/transport + command_success=false; with --fail-on-command exit 1

title: MCP↔CLI name bridge: tz_* aliases or did-you-mean to primary verbs; fix ls/tz_read tips
problem: Savvy/parity: tz_read suggests tree; ls suggests false-success-shell; MCP tz_grep is regex while CLI grep is find-alias. R-009 only asks to document divergences -- agents still fail hard. P0 parity finding.
diff_sketch:
1) Hidden clap aliases or pre-clap argv rewrite: tz_read→read, tz_find→find, tz_shell→run, tz_expand→expand, tz_grep→find (with note).
2) Did-you-mean quality gate: never suggest audit verbs for 1-2 letter shellisms; prefer tree/glob for ls.
3) capabilities.mcp_tools[] + semantic_notes for grep regex split.
4) robot-docs section MCP name map.
test_plan: savvy corpus H01-H19: tz_* either acts or tips primary verb; ls tips tree|glob not false-success-shell

title: Document shared flags on primary verbs (budget/mode/raw/allowed-root/cache-path/timeout)
problem: R-004 covers empty top-level command blurbs; primary-verb --help still lists many flags with empty About. Agents cannot learn --budget vs --max-visible-tokens, --allowed-root, --raw semantics from help alone.
diff_sketch:
Add clap help/long_help on CommonArgs-style fields once; ensure inherit on all context verbs.
Example: --budget 'Alias for --max-visible-tokens; caps visible output tokens'.
test_plan: tokenzero read --help contains non-empty descriptions for budget/allowed-root/raw/cache-path

title: Did-you-mean ranking: edit-distance-1 primary verb first; suppress audit-verb noise
problem: instal tips stats/client-status/init/ingest/install-smoke before install; reed also lists protected-anchor-audit. Wrong ranking teaches noise. Complements R-011/R-013.
diff_sketch:
Custom clap error template: sort suggestions by (edit_distance, is_agent_primary, !is_audit_eval).
Primary set: read find run edit tree glob expand doctor capabilities robot-docs install cache.
Never tip false-success-shell/harm-eval for 1-4 letter tokens.
test_plan: instal first tip=install; ls first tip in {tree,glob,list}; tz_read first tip=read

title: hook claude-code: never exit 0 on empty stdin without payload
problem: tokenzero hook claude-code with empty stdin exits 0 with empty stdout/stderr. Agents cannot detect mis-wired hooks. Never-Silent-Fail violation.
diff_sketch:
If stdin empty/non-JSON: exit 2 with exact example:
  echo '{...PreToolUse...}' | tokenzero hook claude-code --json
Document required schema keys in --help and capabilities.
risk: low -- may break callers that relied on empty success; gate with --allow-empty if needed
test_plan: empty stdin → exit 2 + example; valid fixture → exit 0 JSON decision

title: Enrich doctor --robot-triage to true mega-path (merge bare doctor richness + recs/commands)
problem: R-001/R-010 assumed missing triage. Live: doctor --robot-triage exists but is thinner than bare doctor (10 keys, no recommendations/commands/quick_ref). Root --robot-triage and robot-triage verb fail. Agent surfaces footer does not list triage.
diff_sketch:
1) robot_triage payload = {quick_ref, recommendations, commands, project_health, next_steps, findings_summary} composed from doctor.v1 + capabilities slices.
2) Accept root tokenzero --robot-triage and tokenzero robot-triage as aliases.
3) Footer + capabilities.canonical_invocations.
4) Keep bare doctor full multi-slice for deep debug.
Supersedes conflicting bits of R-001/R-010.
risk: low-medium -- additive schema fields + root aliases
test_plan: doctor --robot-triage --json has recommendations+commands; root --robot-triage exit 0; schema pinned
